statements.impact_statement: Exact Red Hat OpenJDK package version and architecture in Keycloak 26.8.2 only. Both images contain the same noarch ca-certificates RPM version 2026.2.92_v9.0.319-90.3.el9_8, the RHEL 9 package in RHSA-2026:88459. Red Hat states RHEL OpenJDK relies on the system CA bundle; the original CVE-2026-91403 is the insufficient upstream Java-side blocklist, and root removal is tracked separately as CVE-2026-114406. The AMD64 JRE cacerts check found no compromised Comodo AAA Services or emSign ECC Root CA G3 aliases. This statement is loaded only by trivy-keycloak.yaml for the Keycloak 26.8.2 multi-architecture scan; it does not apply to other products, versions or image workflows. Evidence: exact AMD64/ARM64 Trivy inventories and AMD64 trust-store check; https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-91403; https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-114406; https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2026:88459; https://access.redhat.com/security/vulnerabilities/RHSB-2026-012
